# axiz-core-fileformats

CSV and fixed-width records, EBCDIC conversion, checksums and control trailers.

## Dependency

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>pe.axiz</groupId>
  <artifactId>axiz-core-fileformats</artifactId>
</dependency>
```

The version is managed by `axiz-bom` (services inherit `axiz-parent-service`).

## Main types

| Type | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `Checksums` | File checksums for integrity controls with legacy systems. |
| `ControlTotals` | Running totals checked against a file trailer (record count and amount sum). |
| `CsvReader` | Streaming RFC 4180 CSV reader: quoted fields, escaped quotes (`""`), delimiters and line breaks inside quotes, CRLF or LF. |
| `CsvWriter` | RFC 4180 CSV writer. |
| `Ebcdic` | EBCDIC text and packed decimal (COMP-3) conversion for files exchanged with mainframes. |
| `FieldType` | Types of fixed-width fields. |
| `FileFormatException` | Malformed record in a file; carries the line number. |
| `FixedField` | A field of a fixed-width record. |
| `FixedWidthLayout` | Layout of a fixed-width record: parses lines into typed values and formats values back. |

## Tests

Unit tests live in `src/test/java` and document the expected behavior; run them with `./mvnw -pl core/axiz-core-fileformats verify`.
